instruction: Start the toaster. Once the lever pops up, take the bread to the plate on the dining counter.

stage_definitions.counts_as_complete: the bread was in a toaster slot when the lever was pushed down (toaster switched on), and the toasting has since finished: the lever has popped back up.
stage_definitions.does_not_count: the lever has not been pushed down, the bread was not in the slot, or the lever is still down (still toasting).

stage_definitions.counts_as_complete: the toasted bread lies on the plate and the robot has let go of it and moved its gripper away (about 25 cm or more).
stage_definitions.does_not_count: the bread is still in the toaster, still held, not on the plate, or the gripper is still at the bread.
